purpose: Row-count manifest for the pre-decommission pg_dump (founder directive 4, order 1). The Supabase project is NOT deleted until this file is filled from a real dump and committed.
why_empty: The project was paused on 2026-09-04; while paused every data-plane query returns 28P01, so no row count can be obtained. Nothing about the contents of this database may be asserted until the founder completes step D1 of supabase-decommission-checklist.md. In particular: this file being empty is NOT evidence that the database is empty.
row_counts_query: SELECT relname AS table, n_live_tup AS approx_rows FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY 1;  -- then confirm every non-zero table with an exact SELECT count(*)

restore_drill.note: Checklist step D6. A dump that has never been restored is a file, not a backup.
